_about: Deadline day (Stage 6.6, src/sim/career/deadline.ts). The last week of each transfer window opens a war room: a clock from startHour to endHour that the owner moves on one hour at a time. Each hour may bring calls; each call lapses when the clock reaches its expiry. Text lives in src/data/deadline.json.

calls._about: perHour: chance of a call in an hour, by the hour it starts from (busier late). second: chance of another call in the same hour. maxTotal: calls in one day. maxOpen: calls waiting at once. The first hour always brings one.

kinds._about: Relative chance of each kind of call. expires: hours a call waits before it lapses.

lateBid._about: A club bids for one of your players. share: fee as a share of his value. more: asking for more succeeds with this chance and lifts the fee by a share in raise; a failed ask ends the call.

panicSale._about: A club short of cash offers a player cheap. share: fee as a share of value. minOverall: the player must be at least this close to your average starter (negative means below).

freeAgent._about: An agent offers a free agent for your weakest position. quality: generatePlayer quality (0 to 1).

hijack._about: Another club is about to sign a player from a third club for fee; you can beat them to it at fee x beat. If you don't, they sign him when the call lapses.

staff._about: When the owner leaves the staff to it (or never opens the war room): they accept a late bid only at fee >= value x acceptShare for a player outside the starting eleven while the squad is bigger than keepSquad, and never spend the owner's money.

flurry._about: Extra rounds of AI deals as the window shuts.
